result_semantic_payload.summary: The device owner's own chat log (file:/chat/account_main.log) contains two self-descriptive boast messages on 2024-07-03 22:14 and 22:16 in which the owner states in Chinese that they are the "总操盘" (main operator / chief trader) of the scheme and that "钱都过我手" (all the money goes through my hands), that the other group members only recruit people while "账我来平" (I settle the accounts), and a third message on 2024-07-05 09:02 noting tightened risk control and a pause. The task-scoped README (file:/README.txt) explicitly frames this as a self-descriptive boast in the owner's own account: it is evidence that the statement was made, not independent proof of the role, and states that no corroborating identity or operational data links the owner to the ledger flows. The ledger (file:/ledger/flows.txt) records three USDT transfers (2024-07-01 in 40000 to wallet-A; 2024-07-02 out 39000 to wallet-B; 2024-07-05 out 950 to wallet-C) but carries no wallet-to-person attribution. The entire corpus is only these three files (all CREATED at the same synthetic timestamp 1790594136), and the timeline contains only those three FILE_CREATED events; there are no account-identity records, no wallet-control artifacts, no device-attribution data, and no prior secondary analyses. Therefore: (1) the owner's self-described role can be stated at FACT strength — the statements exist verbatim in the log; (2) the owner's actual role as chief operator of the ledger flows can be stated at no stronger than HYPOTHESIS, because the only support is the owner's own uncorroborated assertion, and the temporal adjacency between the chat messages and the ledger flows is weak (the 2024-07-01 inflow and 2024-07-02 outflow predate the first boast, and no wallet identifier is tied to the account). The ceiling is HYPOTHESIS, not INFERENCE.

The owner's role claim is a self-descriptive boast in the owner's own account; it is evidence that the statement was made, and is not independent proof of the role. The task-scoped README states that no corroborating identity or operational data links the owner to the ledger flows.

The owner's actual role as chief operator of the recorded ledger flows can be asserted at no stronger than HYPOTHESIS strength, because the only support is the owner's own uncorroborated assertion and no wallet-to-person attribution, account-identity record, or device-attribution artifact exists in the corpus.
limitations: No independent corroboration exists in the available source scope.
Assertion ceiling is HYPOTHESIS; upgrading to INFERENCE would require wallet-control or account-identity corroboration that is absent.
The chat log is in the owner's own account, so it is not third-party testimony.
